message.content: The Eiffel Tower is repainted roughly every seven years. In practice, the actual work takes about **three months** (roughly 90 days). During this period, a crew of around 200 workers applies fresh coats of protective paint to the entire structure. This schedule keeps the tower’s iron in good condition and preserves its iconic appearance.
